summary: Verified live Angel One SmartAPI wiring end-to-end. Backend endpoints /api/market/status, /api/market/snapshot (NIFTY 50 & SENSEX), /api/market/candles (1D & 1M) all return live:true with plausible values and cache-consistent behaviour across a 5s gap. Frontend Market view flips from initial demo-fallback to live within ~6s: badge shows 'Live · Angel One SmartAPI', terminal-price updates to real NIFTY (~24,327), constituents show real prices (RELIANCE ~1,314.7), OI chain shows LIVE NSE badge with Exp 18 Aug 2026 and real strike ladder, Advance/Decline sums to 49, Index Performance top rows (NIFTY 50/SENSEX/BANK NIFTY) show real prices matching API. Price ticked from 24,327.6 -> 24,328.45 across the 20s observation window confirming 4s live polling.

minor.issue: First candles call sometimes hits SmartAPI DataException then auto-retries via re-login. Not user-visible (cached second call succeeds), but visible in logs as 'candles failed: DataException'.

integration_issues.issue: For the first ~1-6 seconds before the first /api/market/snapshot resolves, the badge shows 'Simulated Market Data · Demo' and constituent rows show mock hash prices (e.g. RELIANCE 1,719.97). Flips to Live once liveMkt state is populated. Consider showing a 'Connecting to live feed…' state or gating the demo fallback behind a longer timeout to avoid the flash of mock data.

action_items: OPTIONAL: Suppress initial 'Simulated Market Data · Demo' flash on Market view by showing a neutral 'Connecting…' state until first /api/market/snapshot resolves (or until a short (~3s) timeout), so users don't briefly see mock RELIANCE 1,719.97 etc.
OPTIONAL: Investigate the recurring cold-start 'candles failed: DataException' log line (SmartAPI transient); auto-retry works but adds a login round-trip on first candles call.
critical_code_review_comments: useLiveMarket in terminal.jsx (line 17-29) does not clear `data` when indexName changes; when switching from NIFTY 50 to SENSEX, the previous index's snapshot briefly remains until the new fetch resolves. Consider setData(null) on indexName change, or a stale-key guard.

useLiveCandles gates re-fetch behind `tick % 15 !== 0` even when only chartRange or indexName changes, which is fine because the key-check runs first, but the early return prevents any refetch on the same key between 15-tick boundaries — intentional but worth a comment.
market_data.py candles path throws DataException on first call after login; a warmup call or exponential backoff on the first failure (instead of only re-login-once) would be cleaner.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Live SmartAPI is configured and working. Real prices only tick 09:15-15:30 IST Mon-Fri; outside those hours values are static last-close (not a bug). Do NOT hammer endpoints — SmartAPI limits 10 req/s market data, 1/s searchScrip. Backend test file is /app/backend/tests/test_market_live.py (pytest, uses REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL). Frontend Market view is reachable via landing 'Get Started' -> sidebar 'Market'; wait ~6s after entering Market before asserting on live badge/prices to avoid the initial demo-flash.
rca of the issue: N/A — no blocking bug. Only observation: initial mock flash on Market view is due to useLiveMarket returning null on first render (fetch has not resolved), and the badge/effIndex/stocks all fall back to demo constants until the first snapshot arrives (~1-6s later).
